entries.short_line: Homing could not settle on one position.
entries.cause: The repeated touches on one axis did not agree closely enough.
what_to_do: Check that nothing is on or under the nozzle.
Wipe the nozzle and the plate, then home again.
entries.escalate: If it keeps happening after a clean plate and a second try, contact support with this code.
entries.dev_detail_hint: Per-tap readings and the tolerance are in the message.

entries.short_line: The printer did not find the plate.
entries.cause: The probe did not trigger before the end of its travel.
what_to_do: Check the plate is in place and clean.
entries.escalate: If it repeats with the plate in place, contact support with this code.

entries.short_line: Lift the nozzle first, then move sideways.
entries.cause: The printer refused a sideways move because the nozzle is touching the plate.
what_to_do: Raise the nozzle with the Z controls.
entries.escalate: If it still refuses with the nozzle lifted, contact support with this code.

entries.short_line: The upload stopped before it finished.
entries.cause: The connection to the printer closed while the file was being sent.
what_to_do: Check the printer is still online.
entries.escalate: If large files keep failing over the same route, contact support with this code.

entries.short_line: A heater stopped warming as expected, so the printer shut down to be safe.
entries.cause: The safety check saw a heater not following its target.
what_to_do: Restart the printer from the notice, then try again.
entries.escalate: If it happens twice, do not keep trying: contact support with this code.
entries.dev_detail_hint: The heater name and temperatures are in the message.
